name: Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 14, 2020 -
06:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Presentation of the Senior Citizen of the Year Award
4B.
Proclamation for the 100th Anniversary of the 19th Amendment Ratification
4C.
Presentation by Sheriff’s Captain Taft regarding mid-year crime statistics
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Oral Communications will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
*If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the September 16, 2020 Special Meeting-Closed Session, September 16, 2020 Regular Meeting, September 23, 2020 Special Meeting-Closed Session, and September 23, 2020 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2020-10-14 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Allsup
Approve the Warrants.
2020-10-14 Item 08B Warrants
8C.
Appointment to the Senior Citizen Commission to fill one unscheduled vacancy. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Mayor’s recommendation to appoint Lambert Ling to the Senior Citizen Commission to fill one unscheduled vacancy with a term ending March 2023.
2020-10-14 Item 08C Appointment to Vacancy on the Senior Citizen Commission
8D.
Treasurer’s Annual Report for the Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 2020 and Investment Policy. Contact Person: Finance Director McBroome
1) Receive and file the Treasurer’s Report for the Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 2020; and 2) Adopt Investment Policy (FO19).
2020-10-14 Item 08D Treasurer's Annual Report and Investment Policy Update
8E.
Gardena Road Sidewalk, Via Molena Curb Ramps and Vulcan Avenue Sidewalk Project (CS18E, CS16C and CS01E). Contact Person: Engineering Specialist Edgeworth
1) Reject all bids from the August 27, 2020 bid opening for the Gardena Road Sidewalk and Via Molena Curb Ramps Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) Project; 2) Authorize staff to add a missing 100-foot sidewalk segment along Vulcan Avenue near Hillcrest Drive to the project; and 3) Authorize staff to re-advertise and rebid the Gardena Road Sidewalk and Via Molena Curb Ramps CDBG Project including the missing 100-foot sidewalk segment along Vulcan Avenue near Hillcrest Drive.
2020-10-14 Item 08E Gardena Road Sidewalk, Via Molena Curb Ramps and Vulcan Avenue Sidewalk
8F.
Contract award for the Senior Center Courtyard Improvements and Equipment Project and approval of Budget Resolution No. 2020-92. Contact Person: Recreation Center Manager Goodsell
1) Award Bid for the Courtyard Improvement Project to Blue Pacific Engineering and Construction; 2) Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute a contract in substantial form as contained in Attachment 1 of the agenda report in the amount of $97,000 and a ten percent (10%) contingency of $9,700 for the patio construction portion of the project in the event that additional work is needed, for a project total not to exceed $106,700; and 3) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2020-92, entitled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2020-21 Budget” in Attachment 2 of the agenda report to allocate $130,400 to the new Senior Center Courtyard Improvements and Equipment Project.
2020-10-14 Item 08F Encinitas Senior Center Courtyard Improvements
8G.
Acceptance of the South Coast Highway 101 Safety and Mobility Project (CS20E). Contact Person: Principal Engineer Bankston
1) Authorize the filing of the Notice of Completion (Attachment 1 of the agenda report) for the project; 2) Authorize the release of the payment bond in full upon the recording of the Notice of Completion; 3) Authorize the release of the performance bond in full one (1) year after the recording of the Notice of Completion; 4) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2020-87, entitled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Accepting the South Coast Highway 101 Safety and Mobility Project (CS20E)” (Attachment 2 of the agenda report) accepting the public improvements for the South Coast Highway 101 Safety and Mobility Project (CS20E) as complete to the satisfaction of the City; 5) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2020-88, entitled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2020-21 Budget” (Attachment 3 of the agenda report) which provides an additional $29,332 in funding for additional pavement rehabilitation work on the South Coast Highway 101 Safety and Mobility Project (CS20E); 6) Ratify Change Order #8 (Attachment 4 of the agenda report) of the South Coast Highway 101 Safety and Mobility Project (CS20E) with Blue Pacific Engineering and Construction for $52,500 in bid quantity overruns based on unit price; and 7) Authorize an increase to the not-to-exceed amount for the construction contract with Blue Pacific Engineering and Construction from $816,750 to a new not-to-exceed amount of $830,978.
2020-10-14 Item 08G NOC for the S101 Highway Safety & Mobility Project
8H.
Regional Transportation Improvement Program Amendment. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Ruess
1) Conduct a Public Hearing related to the proposed projects; and 2) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2020-95, entitled “Resolution of the City of Encinitas Adopting an Amendment to the TransNet Local Street Improvement Program of Projects for Fiscal Years 2021 Through 2025.”
2020-10-14 Item 08H Regional Transportation Program Amendment
8I.
Authorization to Purchase a Compact Street Sweeper. Contact Person: Management Analyst Stratakis
Authorize the purchase of one compact street sweeper in accordance with the attached quote, for an amount not-to-exceed $115,000 (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2020-10-14 Item 08I Street Bikeway Sweeper
8J.
Construction Contract award for the Annual Pavement Rehabilitation, Overlay and Slurry Project (CS20A). Contact Person: Associate Engineer Ballesteros
1) Authorize the City Manager or designee to execute a contract in substantial form as contained in Attachment 1 (of the agenda report) and any necessary amendments and time extensions, in consultation with the City Attorney, with Eagle Paving Company in the amount of $2,004,293 plus 15 percent contingency ($300,644) to construct the Annual Pavement Rehabilitation, Overlay and Slurry Project (CS20A), for a total construction project not-to-exceed amount of $2,304,937; and 2) Authorize the City Manager or designee to execute Contract Amendment No. 3 in substantial form as contained in Attachment 2 (of the agenda report), in consultation with the City Attorney, with Kleinfelder, Inc., in the amount of $288,613 plus 10 percent contingency ($28,861) for construction support on the Annual Pavement Rehabilitation, Overlay and Slurry Project (CS20A) for a total project not-to-exceed amount of $317,474.
2020-10-14 Item 08J Construction Contract for Annual Pavement Rehab CS20A
8K.
Introduction of Ordinance 2020-17 establishing informal bidding procedures under the Uniform Public Construction Cost Accounting Act and Resolution 2020-91 electing to become subject to the Uniform Construction Cost Accounting Procedures. Contact Person: Associate Traffic Engineer Goralka
1) Introduce Ordinance 2020-17, entitled “An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas Adding Chapter 7.20 to the Encinitas Municipal Code Establishing Informal Bidding Procedures Under the Uniform Public Construction Cost Accounting Act” (Attachment 1 of the agenda report); and 2) Adopt Resolution 2020-91, entitled “Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Electing to Become Subject to the Uniform Cost Accounting Procedures” (Attachment 2 of the agenda report).
2020-10-14 Item 08K Uniform Cost Accounting Intro Ordinance
8L.
Budget adjustment to restore original contingency amount for Olympus Park Project (CP14A). Contact Person: Principal Engineer Bankston
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2020-94, entitled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2020-21 Budget” (Attachment 1 of the agenda report) to allocate $205,000 to the Olympus Park project (CP14A).
2020-10-14 Item 08L Budget Adjustment for Olympus Park Project CP14A
8M.
Exclusive Negotiation and Right of Entry Agreement with North Coast Repertory Theatre ("NORTH COAST") to build a performing arts theatre on Lot 16 at the Encinitas Ranch Town Center and authorize the City Manager in coordination with the City Attorney to accept the Irrevocable Offer of Dedication (IOD) on the Parcel pending the outcome of the negotiations. Contact Person: Parks, Recreation and Cultural Arts Director Campbell
1) Authorize the Mayor to execute the attached one-year Exclusive Negotiation and Right of Entry Agreement, in coordination with the City Attorney, with North Coast Repertory Theatre (Attachment 1 of the agenda report); and 2) Authorize the City Manager in coordination with the City Attorney, to proceed with the acceptance of the IOD on the Parcel pending the outcome of the negotiations.
2020-10-14 Item 08M ENA with North Coast Repertory Theatre for Lot 16
8N.
Amendment No. 2 to the Contract for Maintenance of Mechanical Systems at City Facilities Between the City of Encinitas and Countywide Mechanical Systems, Inc. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Wilson
Approve and authorize the City Manager, or her Designee, to execute Amendment No. 2 to the Contract for Maintenance of Mechanical Systems at City Facilities between the City of Encinitas and Countywide Mechanical Systems, Inc., in substantial form as contained in Attachment 1 (of the agenda report), in consultation with the City Attorney, in an amount of $49,277, for a total contract amount not to exceed $476,355. The amendment accomplishes the following: 1. Includes an additional $19,590 for equipment replacement, $26,655 for equipment rehabilitation, and an estimated $4,000 for non-routine repair services performed during the remainder of the contract term which runs through December 31, 2020, as described in the agenda report.
2020-10-14 Item 08N Amendment #2 Countywide Mechanical
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
PROCEDURES FOR PUBLIC HEARINGS ON APPEALS (ITEM 10A): New information such as documents, exhibits, letters, photos, charts, diagrams, videos, etc., WILL NOT be considered by the City Council if presented at this meeting. All material must have been submitted to the City Clerk no less than 7 calendar days prior to this hearing
10.
ACTION ITEMS Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
10A.
Public Hearing to consider a timely-filed appeal of the Planning Commission's approval of the consolidation of two underlying legal parcels, demolition of all onsite structures, and construction of 12 detached dwelling units (11 market rate residential units and one affordable, very low-income unit) in a condominium form of legal ownership utilizing State Density Bonus Law (SDBL); associated site and road improvements, and a temporary construction trailer. CASE NUMBER: APPEAL-004017-2020 and MULTI-002569-2018, BADJ-003989-2020, SUB-002571-2020, DR-002572-2018, and CDPNF-002573-2018 (18-220 TMDB/DR/CDP); APPLICANT: Yim Chun B. and Gloria Family Trust; APPELLANT: David Haist; LOCATION: 555 North Vulcan Avenue (APN 256-090-07) and 571 North Vulcan Avenue (APN 256-090-06)
Deny the appeal, uphold the Planning Commission's approval decision, and adopt the draft City Council Resolution No. 2020-85 (Attachment CC-1 of the agenda report).
2020-10-14 Item 10A Vulcan Appeal - Agenda Report
2020-10-14 Item 10A Vulcan Appeal - Attachment 01 - CC RES 2020-85
2020-10-14 Item 10A Vulcan Appeal - Attachment 02 - Appeal
2020-10-14 Item 10A Vulcan Appeal - Attachment 03 - PC RES 2020-14
2020-10-14 Item 10A Vulcan Appeal - Attachment 04 - PC Agenda Report 2020-08-2020
2020-10-14 Item 10A Vulcan Appeal - Attachment 05 - Appeal Response Letter 2020-09-22
2020-10-14 Item 10A Vulcan Appeal - Attachment 06 - Public Comments Received up to Agenda Posting
10B.
Introduction of City Council Ordinance No. 2020-10, which proposes amendments to Title 30 (Zoning) of the Encinitas Municipal Code and the Local Coastal Plan to update the Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) and Junior Accessory Dwelling Unit (JADU) development standards based on updates to State Law that became effective on January 1, 2020. Contact Person: Planner IV Plagemann
Introduce draft Ordinance No. 2020-10 titled, "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Adopting Amendments to Title 30 (Zoning) of the Encinitas Municipal Code to Address
Changes in State Law Regarding Accessory Dwelling Units and Junior Accessory Dwelling Units" (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2020-10-14 Item 10B ADU Update Intro Ordinance
10C.
Status of the City's Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) program initiatives and recommendations for increasing ADU production. Contact Person: Planner IV Plagemann
Review the information and provide direction to staff on incentive programs to increase ADU production in the City.
2020-10-14 Item 10C ADU Program Status Update
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS - NONE
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM - NONE
13.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
14.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS
15.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
16.
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
